name: Kolasib Ganesh Temple
town_description: Kolasib is the district headquarters of Kolasib district in northern Mizoram, about 66 km south of Aizawl on NH 54 (PIN 796081). A market and transport town on the Aizawl-Assam route, it is overwhelmingly Christian (Mizo Presbyterian majority), with a small Hindu minority - mostly non-Mizo traders, government staff and paramilitary personnel - that maintains the town's few community temples.

travel.road: Approx. 66 km from Aizawl via NH 54; regular buses and shared sumos on the Aizawl-Silchar route.
